title: Known-failure ledger row (JSON Lines: one row per line in ledger.jsonl)
description: A failure is allowed on a tuple only if it matches an ADMITTED row by repo+lane+platform+node_id and its fingerprint matches. Protected journeys can never have rows. Rows are proposed by owners and admitted by M-INT (I-05).

node_id.description: full test node id incl. parameters/subtest

fingerprint.description: normalised exception type + message head + top frame (paths/addresses stripped)

semantics_hash.description: hash of test source + fixtures, to detect changed semantics

baseline.description: the matched parent tuple + CI run where the failure was reproduced

provenance.description: release1-main requires proof the failure pre-exists on main

renamed_from.description: previous node_id; only with a reviewed mapping

expires.description: re-review date; expired rows stop matching
